first.summary:
I labelled all 20 posters (v2-021 to v2-040) in data/benchmarks/gold-v2/, and every file passes `labeling validate` with OK. All 20 are event posters. Values were taken only from the poster images, which I read in the originals, the zoom bands and extra close-up crops. I did not use the manifest's listing fields, TourAPI, file names, outside knowledge or any OCR output.

**Readability of small text:** 6 posters are fully legible, 9 partial and 5 illegible. Organization names were the hardest part. Logos whose names could not be read are recorded with name null, and roles are given only where a role label is printed.

**Slots marked illegible:**
- v2-023: organizations
- v2-024: address and budget_disclosure
- v2-029: programs and contacts

**Year:** v2-034 has no 4-digit year anywhere, so its dates have iso and year null (year_basis absent). The validator lists 2026 as a candidate year, as a warning only.

**Judgment calls the reviewer should check:**
- **Region in the title:** admin_area is filled from a region name printed as its own word in the title (포천, 파주, 미추홀, 함평, 음성, 영등포, 춘천, 서울, 제주). Names fused into another word (광명마당극축제, 원주삼토페스티벌, 처인성) are left absent, following the yesan example.
- **Main festival vs. sub-event:**
  - v2-025: 제63회 belongs to 농업인의 날 (Farmers' Day), not the festival, so edition is absent.
  - v2-040: 오늘만 북클럽 is recorded as a program. The large BOOK/CLUB graphic letters are not recorded as a slogan.
- **Times:** a schedule's raw holds only the date. Operating hours go in schedule.times.

I never opened gold-v2/, OCR output or the manifest, and I edited no repository file other than these 15. Every evidence entry is manual, with no bbox or confidence values.

Decisions the agreement check may disagree on:
- **admin_area**: I marked it present only when a name with its 시/군/구 ending is printed in the venue, address or title. I accepted short province names like 경남, 충남 and 대전. Bare city names (강화, 용인, 여수, 순창, 여주, 강릉, 익산, 목포, 구미) count as absent.
- **Wrapped titles**: lines are joined with one space even where the phrase would normally be one word, e.g. "2026 구미 라면 축제", "삼랑성 역사 문화축제", "강원한돈 페스타".
